status: frozen synthetic/source interface; no live index/origin
authentication: none; explicit reviewed home-LAN metadata publication

query.revision: required on pages after 1; optional first-page revalidation

routes.content_type: application/json exactly; no URL query parameters

binding.library: Both responses carry id/title exactly from paired v2 catalog
binding.revision: Discovery revision; every search requires it. Facet pages after first require it. Mismatch 409 discovery_changed.
binding.catalog_revision: Paired v2 publication revision. Index also binds exact catalog file SHA-256. Every result item uses unchanged v2 media URLs and that catalog revision.
binding.composition: New optional same-origin ASGI composition dispatches the two discovery routes and preserves frozen v2 child handlers. Existing v1/v2/phone apps do not acquire discovery automatically. No launcher/deployment supplied.
binding.lifecycle: Snapshot/index changes require stopped release switch. Live index-file change 503 index_changed; mismatch 503 index_mismatch; shared control disable 403. Clear discovery/catalog/media generations after 409/denial; retain v2 no-store/media lifecycle.

facets.scope: Global counts over published metadata and paired visible catalog, not current-query-conditioned counts.
facets.ordering: Facet items ascending numeric id. pinned_person_ids is separate operator order, <=32, no duplicates; pinned_people contains those exact records in that order on every facet page, independent of pagination.
facets.aliases: Server supplied literal strings including bilingual aliases; never compiled family names. Person-ID/alias mapping and order must be reviewed privately; unresolved mappings are not published.
facets.date: captured_date_bounds is observed min/max taken_day, nullable; no year/month count facets in v1. No created_at/import-date substitution or timezone inference.
facets.locations: Reviewed coarse region IDs/labels only, any match. No raw GPS, geocoding or caption-inferred place identity.
facets.tags: Published tag IDs with kind and provenance_counts. Caption/image/manual/rule/unknown remain distinct; kind person never becomes identity.
facets.themes_topics: Unavailable: no_reviewed_taxonomy. UI must not invent these endpoints or a completed generated taxonomy.

filters.join: AND across present categories. Omitted category imposes no constraint. Empty filters browse all catalog IDs, including unindexed ones.
filters.people: ids with explicit match any/all; reviewed assignments only. All means the same asset contains every selected reviewed person.
filters.tags: ids with explicit match any/all; no identity inference. Sources are reported, not a query constraint in v1.
filters.locations: Array of reviewed IDs; ANY within this category.
filters.media: Array of photo/video/unsupported; ANY within this category.
filters.date: Inclusive from/to recorded capture calendar dates. Either endpoint nullable, at least one required. Unknown capture date cannot match. Invalid/reversed dates 400.
filters.caption: NFKC, Unicode casefold, strip outer query whitespace, literal substring phrase; no stemming, token OR, regex, FTS query syntax or semantic provider.
filters.missing: Missing/unindexed metadata never matches that active filter; it is not proof that a person/tag/location is absent.
filters.invalid: Unknown filter categories 422 unsupported_filter; supported-but-disabled 422 capability_unavailable; invalid/unknown IDs, duplicates, empty selections, malformed dates/types 400. No silent filter drop.

paging.bounds: page 1..100000; page_size 1..100. Search body requires all four top-level keys; never duplicate query/JSON fields.
paging.fingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical normalized filters plus discovery and catalog revision; independent of page and page_size. Same filters/revisions must match when appending pages. Changing filters/page_size resets pagination.
paging.after_last: 200 empty items and has_more false; total remains matched asset count

coverage.index_complete: Only whether metadata rows cover every paired catalog ID; not completeness of people detection, captions, tags or models.
coverage.with_without_values: Observed published values per enabled filter; without includes unknown/unindexed/unpublished metadata, not a proved negative.
coverage.tag_generation_completeness: Always unknown; no completion claim from existing tag rows

privacy: Same direct HTTPS hostname/actual-peer/CORP/no-store boundary as frozen v2; no credentials, original paths, raw GPS, faces/crops/embeddings, legacy fallbacks, live DB writes, models, query logs or alias hardcoding.
remaining: No real index exporter/reviewed mappings/live coverage/native benchmark/launcher/deployment/device acceptance. Reviewed provenance in the file is an operator assertion, not automatic proof from legacy manual flags.
